autoAdjustOverflow.zh-CN: 下拉面板被遮挡时是否自动调整方向。
autoAdjustOverflow.en-US: Whether the dropdown flips automatically when it would be clipped.

autofocus.zh-CN: 挂载后是否自动聚焦输入框。
autofocus.en-US: Whether the input is focused after mount.

clearIcon.zh-CN: 自定义清除图标，showClear 为 true 时有效。
clearIcon.en-US: Custom clear icon, effective when showClear is true.

data.zh-CN: 候选项的数据源，可以是字符串、数字或对象的数组。对象项的 `value` 是选中值，`label` 是候选行的文本（须提供，标记内容经 `renderItem` 渲染），其余字段原样保留，出现在 `renderItem` 的参数里。需替换为新数组才会更新列表。
data.en-US: Data source of the candidates: an array of strings, numbers or objects. An object item's `value` is the picked value and its `label` is the row text (provide it; markup goes through `renderItem`). Other fields are kept as they are and reach the `renderItem` argument. Pass a new array to update the list.

defaultActiveFirstOption.zh-CN: 面板打开后是否默认高亮第一个候选项，此时按 Enter 可直接选中。
defaultActiveFirstOption.en-US: Whether the first candidate is highlighted when the panel opens, so that Enter picks it directly.

defaultOpen.zh-CN: 挂载时是否默认展开下拉面板。
defaultOpen.en-US: Whether the dropdown panel is open on mount.

defaultValue.zh-CN: 非受控时输入框的初始值，只在挂载时读取。
defaultValue.en-US: Initial value of the input when uncontrolled, read on mount only.

dropdownClassName.zh-CN: 下拉列表的类名，落在 `role="listbox"` 元素上。
dropdownClassName.en-US: Class name of the dropdown list, applied to the `role="listbox"` element.

dropdownMatchSelectWidth.zh-CN: 下拉面板的最小宽度是否等于输入框宽度。
dropdownMatchSelectWidth.en-US: Whether the minimum width of the dropdown equals the width of the input.

dropdownStyle.zh-CN: 下拉列表的内联样式，对象的键用 kebab-case，落在 `role="listbox"` 元素上。
dropdownStyle.en-US: Inline style of the dropdown list, with kebab-case keys for an object, applied to the `role="listbox"` element.

emptyContent.zh-CN: data 为空时在下拉面板中显示的内容；加载中时代替它显示加载动画。
emptyContent.en-US: Content shown in the dropdown when data is empty. While loading, the spinner is shown instead.

id.zh-CN: 输入框的 id，供 `<label for>` 关联；使用 `triggerRender` 时落在根元素上。
id.en-US: The id of the input, for `<label for>`; with `triggerRender` it lands on the root element.

insetLabel.zh-CN: 输入框内嵌标签，渲染在前缀位置；设置 prefix 或 triggerRender 时不渲染，也不作为可访问名称。
insetLabel.en-US: Inset label of the input, rendered in the prefix position. It is not rendered, and does not name the component, when prefix or triggerRender is set.

insetLabelId.zh-CN: insetLabel 元素的 id，combobox 与 listbox 的名称引用它；不传时组件在渲染 insetLabel 时生成。
insetLabelId.en-US: The id of the insetLabel element, which names the combobox and the listbox. When omitted, the component generates one while an insetLabel is rendered.

loading.zh-CN: 下拉列表是否显示加载动画；为 true 时代替候选项和空内容。
loading.en-US: Whether the dropdown shows a loading spinner in place of the candidates and the empty content.

maxHeight.zh-CN: 下拉列表的最大高度，数字按 px 处理。
maxHeight.en-US: Maximum height of the dropdown list; a number is in px.

motion.zh-CN: 下拉面板显示、隐藏时是否有动画。
motion.en-US: Whether the dropdown animates when it shows and hides.

onBlur.zh-CN: 焦点离开输入框所在区域时的回调，参数为 FocusEvent；焦点在区域内移动（例如移到清除按钮）时不触发。
onBlur.en-US: Callback when the focus leaves the input area, with the FocusEvent. Moving the focus inside the area, for example to the clear button, does not fire it.

onChange.zh-CN: 输入框内容变化或选中候选项时的回调，参数为当前值。
onChange.en-US: Callback when the input text changes or a candidate is picked, with the current value.

onChangeWithObject.zh-CN: 不生效：组件不读取该属性。
onChangeWithObject.en-US: Has no effect; the component does not read it.

onClear.zh-CN: 用清除按钮清空内容后的回调。
onClear.en-US: Callback after the clear button empties the input.

onDropdownVisibleChange.zh-CN: 下拉面板显示或隐藏时的回调，参数为是否可见。
onDropdownVisibleChange.en-US: Callback when the dropdown shows or hides, with its visibility.

onFocus.zh-CN: 焦点进入输入框所在区域时的回调，参数为 FocusEvent；焦点在区域内移动（例如移到清除按钮）时不触发。
onFocus.en-US: Callback when the focus enters the input area, with the FocusEvent. Moving the focus inside the area, for example to the clear button, does not fire it.

onSearch.zh-CN: 用户输入时的回调，参数为输入的文本。
onSearch.en-US: Callback as the user types, with the typed text.

onSelect.zh-CN: 候选项被选中时的回调，参数为选中值；设置 `onSelectWithObject` 时为去掉内部字段的数据项对象。
onSelect.en-US: Callback when a candidate is picked, with its value, or with the item without internal fields when `onSelectWithObject` is set.

onSelectWithObject.zh-CN: 布尔属性，为 true 时 `onSelect` 收到去掉内部字段的数据项对象，而不是选中值。
onSelectWithObject.en-US: Boolean prop. When true, `onSelect` receives the data item without internal fields instead of its value.

position.zh-CN: 下拉面板的位置，可选值同 Tooltip 的 position。未设置时为 bottomLeft，ConfigProvider 的 direction 为 rtl 时为 bottomRight。
position.en-US: Position of the dropdown; the values are those of the Tooltip position. Unset, it is bottomLeft, or bottomRight when the ConfigProvider direction is rtl.

prefix.zh-CN: 输入框的前缀内容；设置后 insetLabel 不渲染。
prefix.en-US: Prefix content of the input. When it is set, insetLabel is not rendered.

ref.zh-CN: 根 div，包裹输入框或 `triggerRender` 的输出；其 `focus()` 与 `blur()` 作用于输入框。
ref.en-US: The root div that wraps the input or the output of `triggerRender`. Its `focus()` and `blur()` act on the input.

renderItem.zh-CN: 自定义候选项的渲染，参数为数据项本身，返回 JSX 元素；未设置时显示 `label`。
renderItem.en-US: Renders a candidate row. The argument is the data item itself, and the return value is JSX. Without it the row shows `label`.

renderSelectedItem.zh-CN: 选中候选项后输入框显示的文本，必须返回字符串；字符串或数字项收到 `{ value, label }`，对象项收到数据项本身。
renderSelectedItem.en-US: The text the input shows for a picked item; it must return a string. A string or number item receives `{ value, label }`, an object item the item itself.

showClear.zh-CN: 有内容时是否显示清除按钮。
showClear.en-US: Whether to show the clear button when there is content.

size.zh-CN: 输入框尺寸，可选 small、default 或 large。
size.en-US: Size of the input: small, default or large.

stopPropagation.zh-CN: 是否阻止下拉面板上的 click、mousedown 与焦点进出事件冒泡。
stopPropagation.en-US: Whether click, mousedown and focus in/out events on the dropdown stop propagating.

triggerRender.zh-CN: 自定义触发器，替换输入框。参数含 `value`（已选项数组）、`inputValue`、`placeholder`、`disabled`、`autofocus`、`size`、`validateStatus`、`showClear`、`prefix`、`suffix`、`clearIcon`、`aria-label`、`aria-labelledby`、`aria-describedby`、`aria-errormessage`、`aria-invalid`、`aria-required`（其他 `aria-*` 不会传到自定义触发器上）、`onChange`（更新输入文本，触发 onSearch 与 onChange 并展开列表）、`onClear`、`onFocus`、`onBlur` 与 `componentProps`。使用时 `id` 落在根元素上。
triggerRender.en-US: Custom trigger, which replaces the input. Its parameters include `value` (the array of selected items), `inputValue`, `placeholder`, `disabled`, `autofocus`, `size`, `validateStatus`, `showClear`, `prefix`, `suffix`, `clearIcon`, the `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby`, `aria-describedby`, `aria-errormessage`, `aria-invalid` and `aria-required` attributes (other `aria-*` attributes do not reach the custom trigger), `onChange` (updates the input text, calls onSearch and onChange and opens the list), `onClear`, `onFocus`, `onBlur` and `componentProps`. With it, `id` lands on the root element.

validateStatus.zh-CN: 校验状态，可选 default、error 或 warning，只影响展示样式。
validateStatus.en-US: Validation status: default, error or warning. It only affects the style.

value.zh-CN: 当前值。传入后为受控，`undefined` 时按非受控处理。
value.en-US: Current value. Passing it makes the component controlled; `undefined` leaves it uncontrolled.
